body:
Corrects the startup guidance in AGENTS.md: development merges reconcile locally; the hosted reconciliation workflow is dispatched for promotion. No workflow implementation is changed.

The existing Jog → Marathon path built and independently reviewed this documentation change. Attempt 1 failed the documentation gate because the prepared runner lacked the newly admitted roadmap row. Attempt 2 passed after an additive ledger refresh; the attempt counter remains 2/2. No further builder attempt was used.

The first publication also carried unrelated GH1295 preparation documents. An additive publication correction removes that inherited scope while preserving the original commits, both relay transcripts, and execution receipts.

Validation: independent Agy approval of the AGENTS guidance, successful deterministic documentation gate and normal pre-push documentation gate. The additive scope correction uses the same normal documentation push gate. No runtime or workflow edits; no merge authorization is implied.

Closes #1160
